captions.caption: A man picks up a large log from the forest floor.
The man lifts the heavy log onto his right shoulder.
The man balances the log as he prepares to move.
The man walks toward a makeshift shelter in the woods.
The man carries the log through the brush and trees.
The man approaches the main horizontal log of the shelter.
The man begins to lift the log into a vertical position.
The man leans the log against the horizontal shelter beam.
The man holds the log upright to ensure it is stable.
The man adjusts his stance while supporting the log.
The man carefully positions the log as a wall support.
The man leans the log against the fallen tree trunk.
The man makes sure the log is firmly in place.
The man gives the log a final push for stability.
The man lets go, and the log stands against the frame.
The man takes a step back to inspect his work.
The man turns and walks away from the shelter.
The man moves toward a pile of debris in the forest.
The man reaches down to pick up a long branch.
The man carries the branch back toward the camera.
The man prepares to break the branch into pieces.
The man uses his knee to snap the wooden branch.
The man breaks off a small section of the wood.
The man snaps another piece of wood over his knee.
The man continues breaking the branch into smaller sticks.
The man finishes breaking the branch for kindling.
A close-up shows the man shaving wood with a knife.
Fine wood shavings fall onto a pile on a log.
The man scrapes the knife along the wood to create kindling.
The man continues making wood shavings for a fire.
Wood shavings accumulate as the man works with his knife.
The man is focused on creating a pile of dry kindling.
More thin wood shavings are produced from the stick.
The man continues the repetitive motion of shaving wood.
The pile of wood shavings grows larger on the log.
The man continues to shave the wood piece with his knife.
The man stops shaving and puts the knife down.
The man prepares to light the wood shavings.
The man uses a fire starter to create sparks.
Sparks fly from the fire starter onto the shavings.
A small flame catches on the pile of wood shavings.
The fire begins to burn the fine wood kindling.
The man carefully adds more shavings to the flame.
The small fire grows as more material is added.
The man nurtures the small flame in the center.
Smoke rises from the burning wood shavings.
The man adds more wood shavings to build the fire.
The man reaches for more fuel to add to the fire.
The man carefully places more kindling on the fire.
The man picks up the bundle of twigs he broke.
The man places the twigs on top of the growing fire.
The twigs begin to catch fire and produce smoke.
The man arranges the twigs to allow for better airflow.
Smoke billows from the twigs as they start to burn.
The man continues adding small sticks to the fire.
The fire burns steadily as the twigs catch light.
The man watches the small fire develop on the logs.
The man makes minor adjustments to the burning wood.
The fire is now well-established among the twigs.
The man reaches for more wood to maintain the fire.
